title: Task log
description: <port>/state/task_log.json: one entry per step run on this port, with its outcome and cost.

format_version.description: Version of this file's format. Readers refuse any value other than 1.

entries.description: Entries in the order the steps ran.

step.description: Name of the step, such as "build_bridge".

module.description: Dotted module name the step worked on; null for a step over the whole port.

started_at.description: When the step started, ISO 8601 in UTC.

finished_at.description: When the step finished, ISO 8601 in UTC.

outcome.description: Whether the step did its job.

model.description: Model that did the work; null when no model ran or cost capture is not built.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens the model used; null when not captured.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens the model used; null when not captured.

cost_usd.description: Cost of the model calls in US dollars; null when not captured.
